name: origamitextreaderwebextension
description: Reads Origami Text EPUBs (spec v1.0, 4 Sept 2026) in Chrome and Safari from one codebase. Any EPUB 3 opens; Origami ones get the extra behaviour.

scripts.format:check: prettier --check background.js content lib reader test manifest.json
scripts.test:reader: node test/reader-one-page.test.js && node test/reader-position.test.js && node test/reader-toc.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:parser && npm run test:sanitizer && npm run test:reader
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write background.js content lib/library.js lib/origami-epub.js reader test manifest.json
